title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
abstract: arXiv:2610.22292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. translated_title: CAT-催化诚实：面向可迁移大语言模型诚实性的持续对抗训练
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正日益普及于诚实性至关重要的场景中。然而，尽管经过了Alignment训练，这些模型仍然表现出不诚实行为，例如输出与某些知识相矛盾、或不受上下文中可获取信息支持的内容。受一种最初为鲁棒拒绝有害查询而开发的方法的启发，我们提出了面向一致诚实性的持续对抗训练方法（CATCH）。CATCH在保持模型能力的同时，训练模型朝向诚实的回答、远离不诚实的回答。我们在两种架构（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和Qwen3-3.6-27B）上进行了评估。结果表明，仅使用由自我报告场景构建的数百个目标进行训练，CATCH就能让模型习得一种能够稳健泛化并在不同基准测试间迁移的诚实行为。它在MASK基准上一致地减少了压力下的不诚实行为，并在Among Us多智能体游戏中提高了坦白率……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CATCH方法通过持续对抗训练，仅用数百个自我报告场景构建的目标，就能让大语言模型习得可泛化、可跨基准迁移的诚实行为，从而在压力情境下显著减少不诚实表现。
